Premiere Assist CLI

Local media analysis becomes an edit plan you can review. FFmpeg supplies the evidence; a deterministic resolver validates candidate IDs and writes an edit decision list and Premiere delivery package. The model never executes a command. Packages have been imported in manual use; editorial quality still needs evaluation.

PythonFFmpegPremiere XMLEDLPytest

08
Developer toolsPrivate project

NewsTrellis Evidence Organizer

Organises RSS and Atom feeds into a finite daily reading list while keeping sources and corrections attached. Ingestion requires approval, validates URLs against server-side request forgery (SSRF), removes duplicates and groups related items. The existing suite has 145 tests; the interface still needs usability work.

Internal RAG Knowledge Assistant

Built during my Aecho AI internship. A Python pipeline ingests 300+ pages of internal documentation. A Streamlit interface retrieves relevant passages before answering with a local model in LM Studio. Sensitive material stays local; routine lookup fell from minutes to seconds.
